messages:
Alex: heads-up — hitting a nasty edge case running the JS SDK in Cloudflare Workers. auth token refresh fails intermittently. stack traces point at Buffer/stream code paths. anyone seen this?
Maya: yup, saw something similar last week with a demo app. Workers don't have Node Buffer, and some transitive dep used it for HMAC.
Sam: can you paste the error? usually it's `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined` or `TypeError: crypto.createHmac is not a function`.
Alex: `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined` inside our auth package when computing signature for refresh. using SDK v1.4.2. wrangler + esbuild bundle.
Maya: typical fixes: 1) avoid the node crypto path by using `crypto.subtle` (Web Crypto) for HMAC, or 2) add a tiny Buffer shim. both have typing gotchas.
Leo: fwiw the SDK should prefer WebCrypto if running in a globalThis that has `crypto.subtle`. We missed a guard in the retry/auth layer.
Natalie: there are also CJS/ESM packaging issues — if consumers import `require('redwood-sdk')` the bundler sometimes pulls node-only cruft. recommend providing separate `browser` field in package.json and an ESM entrypoint with pure DOM APIs.
Sam: short-term patch that worked for me on a worker: add this at top of your entry worker file:
```js
// tiny Buffer shim for Workers
if (typeof globalThis.Buffer === 'undefined') {
  globalThis.Buffer = {
    from: (s) => new TextEncoder().encode(s)
  }
}
```
then adapt HMAC to use `crypto.subtle`. ugly but fast.
Alex: thanks — that unblocked the demo. but still seeing weird TS errors at compile-time: `Property 'subtle' does not exist on type 'typeof crypto'` in tsserver.
Maya: that is the classic dom vs node libs mismatch. add "lib": ["es2020", "webworker", "DOM"] to tsconfig for worker code. also ensure `types": ["@cloudflare/workers-types"]` if using wrangler.
Leo: for SDK maintainers — can we add a small note in README and a guard to prefer WebCrypto + fall back to a minimal shim? Also add `exports`/`browser` fields to package.json so bundlers don't accidentally pull node-only impls.
DevBot: deploy-hook: created issue #3421 to prefer WebCrypto in auth flow and document Cloudflare Worker dev hints.
Natalie: another gotcha: AbortController behavior differs in Workers. our retry logic uses node AbortSignal.timeout conveniences which aren't in Workers. we should never call `new AbortController().signal.withTimeout()` — not supported.
Sam: option: polyfill AbortController with `light-abort-controller` or rewrite retry to use `setTimeout` + abortController.abort() so it's portable.
Alex: final note — when testing on Wrangler, use `wrangler dev --remote` occasionally because local emulation can hide these issues. remote helps catch real env mismatches.
Maya: agree. I'll draft a short devex doc with code snippets: tsconfig, minimal Buffer shim, WebCrypto HMAC example, and recommended package.json fields.
Alex: awesome — thanks. next up: adding a quick e2e test running on a real worker to our CI so we don't regress.
Leo: tagging in the SDK owners in issue #3421. :thumbsup:
Natalie: cc @Alex @Maya if you want me to review the doc before publishing.
